name: Venomancer Sea Serpent Form shows the Aquatic Form incarnation
contract: Sea Serpent Form 803212 is the Venomancer's Aquatic Form: it is not a shapeshift but a transform to creature 5872 (display 4480), so it carries no form id for AppearanceCategories.dbc field 20/21.

With the Aquatic Form category (20) open to the Venomancer, a selected Aquatic Form incarnation replaces the serpent model while the form lasts: appearance 47619 = display 48887. The model follows a selection made inside the form and survives logging in again; clearing the selection brings the serpent back and leaving the form restores the character.
